title: fix(plugin-auth)!: a self-serve social creation is admitted only with a provider-verified address under an address-based posture
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing: a creation admitted today is refused; owes one CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review before the queue)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches the audience posture or a social-provider sign-in; `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` and `content/docs/deployment/tenancy-modes.mdx` gain the rule in this change.

No-card security order (seat `security#1`); there is no issue to close.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`email_domain` 准入模式下，以及 `open` 模式在邮箱验证生效时，经社交登录（`socialProviders`）新建账号，只有在提供方报告邮箱已验证时才准入；否则在准入闸门处以 `403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` 拒绝，与 `invite_only` 一致：不建账号、不发会话、不建成员关系。发给该地址的待处理邀请也不放行这种创建。
- 为什么改：执行维护者对本单的裁决：准入建立在邮箱地址之上的模式，社交登录新建账号须由提供方验证该地址；规则按创建类别判定，之后新增的社交提供方自动覆盖，不需逐个登记。
- 风险与回滚：BREAKING（窄化）。在 `email_domain`、或验证生效的 `open` 部署上，依赖「提供方报告未验证邮箱」也能注册的社交登录改为被拒。运营方注册的身份提供方（`oidcProviders`、SSO）、管理员创建、SCIM、全新安装的首个账号、部署声明关闭验证的 `open` 均不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/audience-posture.ts` 的 `decideAudienceAdmission`（���表守卫之后、邀请豁免之前新增的一条判定）与 `admissionRestsOnAddress`；`auth-manager-membership-admission.ts` 向判定传入的三个输入；`invitation-acceptance-verified-address.test.ts` 末尾新增的顶层 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/invitation-acceptance-verified-address.test.ts src/audience-posture.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件、125 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（窄化在入队前先有一次 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 审核记录）。

## What changes

**The rule.** Under an audience posture whose admission rests on the address (`email_domain` always; `open` while email verification is in force), a self-serve creation through a social provider is admitted only when the provider verified the address. Otherwise it is refused at the admission gate with `403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, as `invite_only` already refuses it: no account row, no session, no membership. The binding rule and ADR-0093 are unchanged.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/audience-posture.ts`: `decideAudienceAdmission` gains the rule as one predicate, after the creation-class exemptions, the bootstrap carve-out and the vocabulary guard, and before the invitation carve-out and the posture switch, so every admit after it is covered. Its input gains `method`, `emailVerified` (verified only when it is `true`) and `declaredEmailVerification`, which the decision resolves through `resolveEmailVerificationRequirement`, the resolver the better-auth wiring and the public config already read; absent resolves to the posture default, so under `open` the rule holds unless the deployment declared an explicit `false`. Two module-private helpers: `isSocialProviderCreation` (a `self-serve` creation whose method is `oauth`, which is how a social provider is told apart from an operator-registered `oidcProviders` entry, already classed `provider`) and `admissionRestsOnAddress`. The module doc gains the section "A social provider's word on the address", and the invitation carve-out paragraph names the exception.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-membership-admission.ts`: `validateAudienceAdmission` hands the decision the vendor's `source.method`, `user.emailVerified` and the live `emailAndPassword.requireEmailVerification`. Nothing else in the gate moves.
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` (OAuth callback section), `content/docs/deployment/tenancy-modes.mdx` (membership reconciler bullet) and `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` (the `email_domain` invitation paragraph and "Email verification under each posture") state the rule.
- `.changeset/social-creation-needs-provider-verified-address.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, the two declaration lines, `Skills-docs:`, the ADR-0087 disposition and the BREAKING note with what to do.

**Decisions this order left to the PR, and which way each went:**

- **The off-allowlist invitation case takes the same refusal.** Under `email_domain`, an address off the allowlist that a pending invitation is addressed to, signing in through a social provider that did not verify it, is now refused like any other unverified social creation, rather than keeping the outcome #34969 pinned for it. Why: the invitation is matched by the very address the provider did not verify, and `invite_only` already refuses an unverified OAuth creation whatever invitation is addressed to it (`invitationProofFor`), so one rule reads the same under every posture and the refusal leaves nothing behind. Nobody is dead-ended: once the provider verifies the address the same person is admitted and accepts the invited role (pinned), and the email-and-password sign-up and the invitation mail's one-step link keep working as before. The same holds for an invitation under `open` with verification in force.
- **The bootstrap carve-out stays ahead of the rule**, as it does under `invite_only`: the first account of a fresh install is admitted whatever the provider said (pinned at the decision level).
- **The refusal reuses `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`**, the code `invite_only` already answers this creation with, with its own description naming the posture. No error code is added, so the ADR-0112 ledger does not move.
- **An off-allowlist address with no invitation** now meets this refusal rather than `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` when the provider did not verify it, because the rule sits ahead of the posture switch; with a verified address it still meets `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`. Every non-social creation keeps its refusal codes.

## Tests

All counts below are vitest's own summary lines; red was taken on the unfixed source, green and the ablation on `9f4fd3cd`.

- **Red before the fix, on the real engine** (`AuthManager` over `@objectstack/driver-sql` on better-sqlite3, the real `/sign-in/social` door): 10 of the new pins fail and every control passes (`Tests 10 failed | 115 passed (125)`). The red set includes the three real-engine refusal pins (`email_domain` on the allowlist, `open` with verification in force, the off-allowlist invitation case).
- **Green after the fix**: `Tests 125 passed (125)` on the two files; `144 passed` across those two plus `presented-invitation.test.ts` and `audience-bootstrap-seam.test.ts`; the whole package `Test Files 285 passed (285)`, `Tests 6014 passed | 10 skipped (6024)`.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, with a trap restore): the predicate's first operand replaced so the rule never fires. Mutation proven on disk (anchor x1 -> x0, blob `f2f2b8a4` -> `1879d950`); the run reds exactly the 10 refusal pins (`Tests 10 failed | 115 passed (125)`) while every control stays green; restored blob equals HEAD (`f2f2b8a4`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

New pins, named by the rule:

- `invitation-acceptance-verified-address.test.ts`, new top-level describe "under an address-based audience posture, a self-serve social creation is admitted only with a provider-verified address": refusal under `email_domain` on the allowlist and under `open` with verification in force (403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, not signed in, and the `sys_user` / `sys_account` / `sys_session` / `sys_member` row counts unchanged); CONTROL: a provider-verified sign-in admits, signs in and binds to the default organization under both; CONTROL: `open` with the deployment's verification declared off admits as before.
- Same file, the `email_domain` invitation describe: the off-allowlist invitation case is refused with nothing written and the invitation still pending, then the provider-verified sign-in is admitted and accepts the invited role.
- `audience-posture.test.ts`, two new top-level describes: the decision matrix (only `emailVerified === true` counts; `email_domain` whatever the deployment declares; an invitation does not admit; `open` refused while verification is in force; CONTROL rows for `open` with verification off, the `provider` and `operator` classes, every other self-serve method, the bootstrap carve-out and `invite_only`) and the real manager's gate (any social providerId, one configured later included, refused; an `oidcProviders` entry and an `sso-oidc` provider admitted whatever they said; `open` forced vs declared off).

## Acceptance notes

- Three existing cases in `invitation-acceptance-verified-address.test.ts` drove a social account whose provider did not verify the address under `open` with verification in force; that creation is now refused. They now run under `open` with the deployment's verification declared off (`OPEN_VERIFICATION_OFF`), the one deployment where such an account is still created, so the accept, decline and listing rules for it stay exercised; their assertions are unchanged.
- That file's `deployment()` now boots the self-registration permission set for `open` as well as `email_domain`, because an uninvited sign-up under `open` is granted the declared set; no existing case's outcome depends on it.
- The console's callback page maps `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` to its "not invited" sentence (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`), whose docblock names only the `invite_only` emitter. For this refusal an invitation is not the remedy; the server's description, behind the page's technical details, names the remedy. Not changed here (outside this order's file surface); raised as an open question in the report.
- The rule is told by creation class and method, so it covers every `oauth` creation that is not an `oidcProviders` entry, a social provider added later included. Other self-serve methods are unchanged by design: email-and-password keeps its forced verification before a session, and magic link and email OTP prove the mailbox in their own flow.
- `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts` is not touched: the forced verification there still reaches `emailAndPassword` only, and the rule lives in the admission decision instead of a per-provider requirement.
